learning_outcomes.text: To give knowledge and practical skills for modelling, analysis and synthesis of automatic control systems.

syllabus_topics: Control systems: basic concept and definitions, classifications
Mathematical models of linear continuous-time control systems: differential equations, transfer functions, block diagrams
P, PI, PD and PID controllers

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (problem solving and question answering)

assessment_rules: Students must attend all classes and write a course assignment to be allowed to take the exam. The practical performance mark and the course assignment mark are both considered when forming the final course grade.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
